title: Stand Finance
tagline: b2b defi vaults risk assessment SDK integrated by dapps, accesible to consumers on the frontend
description:
Project Title: Chaos Monkey Risk SDK (EthGlobal Cannes 2026 Submission) Product Type: B2B 1-Line SDK / React Widget Core Value Proposition: An autonomous, AI-powered "Risk-as-a-Service" tool that protocols embed on their frontends. It simulates cascading vault failures and depeg risks in real-time, subsidized by the protocol via gas-free micropayments.

1. The Architecture Flow
User Action: A retail user visits a DeFi protocol's frontend and clicks "Run Live Risk Simulation" on a specific vault via the integrated React widget.
Monetization (Arc): The protocol’s treasury automatically signs an off-chain authorization (EIP-3009) to stream a $0.05 USDC nanopayment to the SDK provider using Circle's Nanopayment API.
Orchestration & Data (Chainlink): The payment confirmation triggers a Chainlink CRE (Runtime Environment) workflow. The workflow securely fetches real-time, tamper-proof vault state data (TVL, live token prices, DEX liquidity depth) via HTTP capabilities.
AI Compute (0G): Chainlink passes the verified data payload to a decentralized multi-agent swarm built on the OpenClaw framework. The agents use 0G Compute to run the complex "Chaos Monkey" depeg simulation.
Storage & Delivery (0G): The agents compile a final risk report, write it to 0G Storage for persistent memory, and return the simplified Risk Score to the protocol's frontend widget.
